question: Ritesh and Gauri have to travel from Delhi to Kanpur in their respective cars. Ritesh is driving at 150 km/hr while Gauri is driving at 60 km/hr. Find the time taken by Gauri to reach Kanpur if Ritesh takes 8 hours.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When distance is constant, Speed ∝ 1 / Time.

Speed Ratio (Ritesh : Gauri) = 150 : 60 = 5 : 2

Time Ratio (Ritesh : Gauri) = 2 : 5

Given 2 units → 8 hours (Ritesh's time)

Then 5 units → (8 ÷ 2) × 5 = 20 hours.

**∴ The correct answer is 20 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of Ritesh = 150 km/hr

Time taken by Ritesh = 8 hours

Speed of Gauri = 60 km/hr

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

Time = Distance ÷ Speed

 
• 
 
 
 Delhi
 Kanpur
 Distance = Constant
 
 
• 
 

 Ritesh: Speed = 150 km/hr, Time = 8 hr
 
 
• 
 

 Gauri: Speed = 60 km/hr, Time = ?

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = Speed of Ritesh × Time taken by Ritesh

⇒ Total Distance = 150 × 8 = 1200 km

Since Gauri has to cover the same distance, we use her speed to find the time.

⇒ Time taken by Gauri = Total Distance ÷ Speed of Gauri

⇒ Time taken by Gauri = 1200 ÷ 60

⇒ Time taken by Gauri = 20 hours

**∴ The correct answer is 20 hours.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed

It is defined as Total Distance ÷ Total Time. When equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, Average Speed = (2xy) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, relative speed is the sum of their speeds (x + y). When moving in the same direction, it is the difference (x − y).

Speed, Distance & Time Relation

When distance is constant, speed is inversely proportional to time (S₁ × T₁ = S₂ × T₂). When time is constant, distance is directly proportional to speed.
